description: Assembly-line test measurement normalizer: extracts normalized measurement records from unstructured Excel test dumps

measurements.description: Extract EVERY individual test measurement in the document as its own record, reading top to bottom across all stations (Torque, Press Fit, Leak, Vision, Functional, Electrical, Pack-Out) and including retries, reworks, and retests. RULES: (1) One record per distinct measured characteristic. When one source line reports multiple characteristics (for example torque AND angle, press force AND insertion depth, or motor speed AND vibration AND output voltage), emit a SEPARATE record for each characteristic, all sharing the same sourceRecordText. (2) ANTI-FRAGMENTATION: treat each physical source row as ONE logical event even when its values are spread across multiple adjacent cells or wrapped lines. Reconstruct a value that is split across cells (for example 'actual | 18.61 | Nm' or 'peak | 4.82 | kN') into a single complete measurement. Do NOT emit a record for a bare value, unit, or label fragment. (3) Every record MUST include a serialNumber and a result: carry the serial number and pass/fail outcome from the governing unit/line context when they are not repeated on the same cell. If a fragment genuinely has no associated serial number or outcome, do not emit it. (4) Copy the complete original source line verbatim into sourceRecordText. (5) Skip banner, title, section-divider, and station-summary lines that contain no measurement value.

eventTimestamp.description: Measurement time in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) when present in the source line; otherwise empty.

workOrder.description: Manufacturing work order or production order, e.g. NS-84721.

serialNumber.description: Serial number of the assembled unit, e.g. AX10001.

shift.description: Production shift such as Day or Night.

stationId.description: Machine, bench, or inspection station identifier, e.g. STN-01, L-2, V4, FTB-07.

testCategory.description: High-level test family such as Torque, Press Fit, Leak, Vision, Functional, Electrical, Pack-Out, or Line Note.

measurementName.description: Normalized name of the measured characteristic, e.g. 'Joint J1 torque', 'Peak press force', 'Pressure drop'.

measurementValue.description: Numeric test result; leave empty for status-only records.

measurementUnit.description: Engineering unit for the measurement, e.g. N·m, kN, mm, kPa, deg, A, rpm, V, ohm, %, count.

lowerSpecLimit.description: Minimum acceptable value when defined in the source.

upperSpecLimit.description: Maximum acceptable value when defined in the source.

targetValue.description: Nominal or target value when known.

testDurationSeconds.description: Test duration in seconds when stated.

result.description: Normalized outcome, exactly one of: PASS, FAIL, REVIEW, HOLD, INFO. Map OK/GOOD/Y/accepted/'release approved' to PASS; map FAIL-LOW/FAIL-HIGH/NG/reject to FAIL; keep REVIEW, HOLD, and INFO as-is.

attemptNumber.description: Test or retest sequence number; first attempt is 1, retry/rework is 2 or higher.

errorCode.description: Normalized failure or review code, e.g. TORQUE_LOW, LEAK_HIGH, LABEL_SKEW, OCR_GLARE.

operatorId.description: Operator or technician identifier from the source, e.g. K17.

fixtureId.description: Fixture, nest, or tooling identifier, e.g. 7A.

recipeId.description: Machine recipe or test program identifier, e.g. R19.

ambientTempC.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Celsius when reported.

humidityPct.description: Relative humidity on a 0-to-100 scale when reported.

sourceRecordText.description: REQUIRED. The complete original unstructured source line this record was derived from, copied verbatim (including timestamps, separators, and units) for traceability. Never leave this empty.

notes.description: Optional mapping assumptions, warnings, or supplemental context; empty when none.
